units.source_text: 美国兵看到了常绿树上被积雪压弯了的叶子后面清晰可见的红果实，

en.t: The American soldier saw the red berries clearly visible behind the leaves of the evergreen tree, bent down under the snow,
and asked me what they were.
I could only answer that it was an evergreen tree.

units.source_text: 也许他是个与他那彪形躯体不相称的抒情诗人，

en.t: Perhaps he was a lyric poet, ill matched to that hulking body of his,

units.source_text: 但他的明亮眼睛却露出了几分残酷。

en.t: but his bright eyes revealed a certain cruelty.

units.source_text: 在《鹅妈妈》这首外国童谣里，把黑眼睛唱成坏心眼，而且是残酷的。

en.t: In that foreign nursery rhyme Mother Goose, black eyes are sung of as wicked-hearted, and cruel as well.

units.source_text: 大概人托异国的东西来梦想其残酷性是一种惯例吧。

en.t: Perhaps it is customary for people to entrust their dreams of cruelty to things from foreign lands.
